newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil in European tracks lower Malaysian market.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil in European tracks lower Malaysian market.

text.p: Palm oil sellers were lower in Europe at midday on Tuesday following the easier close in Malaysia.
Kuala Lumpur palm oil futures dipped towards the close on profit-taking and as some players liquidated positions following a slow-down in demand on the physical market from refiners.
Crude palm oil in Europe slipped by up to $5 while products were mixed at $2.50 up to $5 down.
Soft oils were supported by higher soy oil futures in Chicago and a firmer dollar.
Chicago futures rose on rumours of export business and spreading between soy oil and soy meal.
At midday In Europe Dutch soy oil was 1.50 to one guilder higher while rape oil was 0.50 to one guilder up.
Crude palm oil sellers were unchanged to $5 down while RBD palm oil was $2.50 up to unchanged in tradeless markets.
Olein sellers were $5 down to unchanged after May traded at $597.50 and Jun at $585 a tonne a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Lauric oils followed the mostly easier trend in palm oil with coconut oil sellers $2.50 down and palmkernel oil unchanged to $5 lower.
Traders said buyers were out of sight of the sellers.
